content: The world starts as a 1 by 1, but for every new advancement earned, it expands. Can we complete every Minecraft task in such small world? This challenge was completed with the Blaze and Caves Advancement pack: https://modrinth.com/datapack/blazeandcaves-advancements-pack Blaze and Caves Border Expansion mod by @sloimay The mod will soon be released on my Discord! Where I get my music: https://share.epidemicsound.com/30xq36 Discord: https://discord.gg/6pBBqCF3BW This is another border challenge like Every Unique Item Expands the Border

chineseContent: 世界一开始是一一的，但每取得一个新的进步，它就会扩展。我们能在这么小的世界里完成《我的世界》的所有任务吗？这项挑战是通过 Blaze and Caves Advancement pack 完成的：https://modrinth.com/datapack/blazeandcaves-advancements-pack 由 @sloimay 制作的 Blaze and Caves Border Expansion mod 该 mod 很快就会在我的 Discord 上发布！我从哪里获取音乐：https://share.epidemicsound.com/30xq36 Discord：https://discord.gg/6pBBqCF3BW 这是另一个边界挑战，就像每个独特的项目都会扩展边界一样
